name: scriptexts smoke validator browser gate r13
description: Adds an opt-in managed Playwright interaction smoke gate to the content-site-modernizer Devtool validator via PLAYWRIGHT_SMOKE=1 while preserving fast browser-free validation by default.

commit.message: Add opt-in managed browser smoke validator gate

notes: Default Devtool validation remains browser-free and fast.
Set PLAYWRIGHT_SMOKE=1 to make the validator run npm run smoke:content-sites:interactions:managed with retain-on-failure trace and snapshot artifacts.
PAGETUAL_SCRIPT may override the PageTual userscript path; otherwise the validator defaults to $HOME/Downloads/Pagetual-1.9.37.132.user.js.
The opt-in gate fails clearly if PLAYWRIGHT_SMOKE=1 is set and the PageTual script is missing.
